metadata.situation: First greet the visitor, then explain the study, then ask for consent.

assumptions: Each step plays a scene, so the bare EEDGE chain gives true step-after-step ordering: PlayScene blocks the node until the scene has finished playing.
Scenes greet, explain_study and ask_consent are assumed to exist in the SceneScript. The capability snapshot carries no scene inventory, so this cannot be validated here.
Positions are emitted by the template rather than left to the pipeline, so the chain reads left to right and does not collide with existing nodes.
AskConsent is the final step and deliberately has no outgoing edge. A real sequence should be given a continuation target.

operations.reason: Third and final step of the sequence.
